feature: Alleato AI feedback routing and guarded Prime Contract SOV editing

flows.name: Feature-gap feedback routing
steps: Open Alleato AI with Nexcom selected
Submit the exact feature-gap confirmation wording
Inspect the assistant tool trace and response
flows.expectedOutcome: The assistant uses the feedback workflow and does not return a project briefing

flows.name: Existing Prime Contract SOV preview
steps: Open the Nexcom draft Prime Contract
Ask Alleato AI to preview a change to cost code 01-3120
Inspect the preview and stop before confirmation
flows.expectedOutcome: The assistant returns an edit preview with an explicit confirmation boundary and does not mutate the contract

flows.name: Protected confirmed write
steps: Exercise invalid permission, stale-state, and token cases
Exercise the exact confirmed preview through the atomic RPC test double
flows.expectedOutcome: Only the exact authorized draft-state preview can reach the atomic write

claims.description: Explicit feature-gap confirmations reach the feedback workflow instead of project briefing retrieval
Alleato AI can preview an existing draft Prime Contract SOV edit from the global chat surface without applying it
Confirmed SOV writes require the exact authorized preview and fail closed on permission or state drift
